'''"The Dagger"''' was an unscalable rock spire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] southern point. At the base of the Dagger stood a collection of villages called [[Dox Piter]]. A legendary conflict took place between the beast [[Wodnakki]] and the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Guard]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]] after the former built a nest atop the spire.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dagger is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' in the codex entry 'The Dagger at Dox Piter.'<ref name="Codex" />
